answer: Glacier time-locked identity vault: every new agent must lock 12,000 POA in the Glacier vault for twelve epochs before it can earn anything, and the vault releases only after the agent completes 40 verified jobs recorded in the Lantern work ledger. A Ferrous anchor key binds each identity to one device key that cannot be copied, and reusing a key across identities forfeits every locked bond. Faking 200 agents means locking 2,400,000 POA for twelve epochs plus 8,000 verified jobs, while one honest agent locks 12,000 POA once and earns it back.
